caveats:
18 administrative level 2 islands have duplicate names within their administrative level 1 atoll.

Within administrative level 1 atoll “Gaafu Dhaalu” [MV017] these are:  two administrative level 2 islands called “Aakirahuttaa” [MV017014] and [MV017015], three islands called “Bodehuttaa” [MV017021], [MV017022], and [MV017023], three called “Dhoonirehaa” [MV017009], [MV017038] and [MV017039], two called “Haveyyerataa” [MV017067] and [MV017068], and two called “Maarehaa” [MV017141] and [MV017142].

Within atoll “Laamu” [MV015] these are two called “Bodufinolhu” [MV015018] and [MV015019] and two called “Boduhuraa” [MV015020] and [MV015021].

Finally, within atoll “Gaafu Alifu” [MV016] there are two called “Maadhigavara” [MV016083] and [MV016084].
